name: Little Prince Common Rose
description: In The Little Prince, the “common rose” represents something that looks ordinary when you judge it from the outside. At first, the Little Prince thinks his rose is special. Then he sees thousands of identical roses and feels disappointed — he believes his rose is just common, nothing unique. But later he understands the key lesson of the story. What makes the rose special isn’t how rare it is, but the relationship he has with it. He watered it. He protected it. He spent time with it. Because of that care and responsibility, his rose becomes unique to him, even if it looks the same as others. So the meaning of the common rose is: something ordinary that becomes meaningful through love and attention proof that value comes from connection, not scarcity a reminder that what truly matters is often invisible to the eyes A common rose becomes special because someone chose it.
